svg.title: stablyai/orca: 4.8% AI-signed commits
svg.desc: 4.8% of 500 recent commits in stablyai/orca carry a disclosed AI agent signature (newest 500 commits, since 2026-11-01). Claude Code 4%, GitHub Copilot 0.6%, OpenAI Codex 0.2%. No signature found does not mean human-only.
